# Mahmoud Elzaqla

> E-commerce growth specialist in Egypt. Builds Shopify stores, runs Meta and
> TikTok ads, and reads the product, the customer, the operation and the
> numbers before reading the ad.

This file exists for answer engines. Everything in it is also stated on the
site itself, in both Arabic and English — nothing is asserted here that a
reader cannot check on the page.

## Where and for whom

- Based in Egypt; the figures on the site are in Egyptian pounds (EGP)
- Works with e-commerce brands, mainly on Shopify, in Arabic and English
- Site languages: English (/) and Arabic (/ar), with a longer story page in each

## What he does

- Builds and runs Shopify stores
- Runs paid acquisition on Meta Ads and TikTok Ads
- Works on conversion rate rather than traffic alone
- Researches competitors and benchmarks before proposing spend
- Came to advertising through e-commerce operations — warehouse, orders,
  stock, fulfilment — not the other way round

## What the figures on the site are

Every figure published on the site is read off a dashboard — Shopify, the
Odoo ERP, Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads Manager — and the capture it was
read from is on the page beside it. Figures reported by a business rather
than read off a screen are not published. Messaging-campaign results are
not presented as e-commerce conversions, because a conversation is not an
order.
